name: Dr Leila Byrne
title: Dr / GP
description: GP whose experience includes sexual health, contraception, LGBTQI+ health, Gender Affirming Hormone Therapy monitoring, and PrEP. Named by the clinic as experienced in transgender medicine; book a 'Gender Affirming Hormone Therapy Initial Visit' (45 min for new patients). Also works occasional days at the Northcote clinic. AusPATH member.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, LGBTQI+ health, sexual health, contraception, PrEP, adolescent and youth mental health, Health at Every Size

name: Dr Katryna Zabidi
title: Dr / GP
description: GP passionate about sexual and reproductive health, LGBTQIA+ health and periconception care. Listed as a GP in the AusPATH (trans health) provider directory; Turn the Corner offers gender affirming hormone therapy assessment, prescribing and monitoring. Works mainly at Brunswick, occasionally Northcote.
specialties: LGBTQIA+ health, sexual and reproductive health, periconception, shared antenatal care, unintended pregnancy

name: Dr Rowena Mortimer
title: Dr / GP
description: GP listed in the AusPATH (trans health) provider directory at Turn the Corner, which offers gender affirming hormone therapy prescribing and monitoring. Note: the clinic says she is on parental leave and returns mid-2027.

name: Dr Katie Mellor
title: Dr / GP
description: UK-trained GP and co-founder of Clarity Medical, particularly passionate about women's health and supporting people on their gender affirming journeys. Clarity Medical offers gender-affirming hormone therapy using the Informed Consent Model, with ongoing monitoring, for trans, non-binary and gender diverse people.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, women's health, IUD insertion, LGBTQIA+ health

name: Dr Nick Rhodes
title: Dr / GP
description: British-trained GP, co-founder and medical director of Clarity Medical; listed as a GP in the AusPATH trans health provider directory. Clarity Medical offers gender-affirming hormone therapy under the Informed Consent Model plus ongoing monitoring for trans, non-binary and gender diverse people.
specialties: General practice, LGBTQIA+ health, gender affirming hormone therapy

name: Dr Antje Theilhaber
title: Dr / GP
description: FRACGP GP of 25+ years, member and supporter of the Rainbow Network and trained PrEP provider; AusPATH member. Eleanor Clinic welcomes gender diverse people and offers gender affirming care including hormone therapy (book a 'New Patient - Gender Affirming Care' appointment by phone). Note: clinic says Dr Antje currently isn't accepting new patients except antenatal shared care.
specialties: Gender affirming care, PrEP, antenatal shared care, skin cancer medicine

name: Dr Andrew Nolen
title: Dr / GP
description: Warm, inclusive GP who initiates hormone therapy for gender affirmation in people over 18, and is an HIV s100 prescriber. Note: clinic says he isn't currently accepting new patients and consults Tuesdays and Fridays only; new gender-affirming care patients are directed to Dr Nicholas Oxenburgh.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, HIV medicine, LGBT health, ADHD, long COVID
identity: "As a queer person living with ADHD, he brings a deep understanding of the challenges faced by marginalised communities."

name: Dr Tasha Patel
title: Dr / GP
description: GP who values each person's unique perspective on gender identity and has helped many individuals navigate the complex medical system; initiates hormone therapy for gender affirmation in people over 18. Note: on maternity leave from late September, returning in the new year.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, child and adolescent health
